We create a resilient network infrastructure that withstands peak loads and easily scales to your business needs. We not only design and implement solutions but also ensure their reliability: all equipment is tested in our laboratory, and we take responsibility for further operation and support. You get not just a set of technologies but a ready tool to improve operational efficiency.

Our team includes more than 200 engineers — experts in networks, unified communications, and infrastructure solutions. We accompany each project from concept to operation to make your IT environment a reliable foundation for achieving business goals.

«We have located our data center separately from the main building. This simplifies maintenance and provides a clear understanding of the integrity of server communications: modular data centers are energy-independent and do not intersect with the communications of the office building. We are currently continuing the process of transferring the company's information systems to new equipment, and in the future we will consider applying mobile data center technology at other company sites.».

«For effective work in a hybrid format, it was important for us to consider many nuances: to create zones for meetings and brainstorming while maintaining a comfortable noise level, to provide high-tech workplaces, to provide storage areas for personal belongings, and to equip employees with all the necessary devices for remote work. As a result, a truly comfortable and functional coworking area was created, meeting all business needs while harmoniously integrated into the overall office design.»
